heading: State tax
lead: A State or political subdivision thereof may not collect or levy a tax, fee, head charge, or other charge on—

tree.text: a passenger traveling in interstate commerce by motor carrier;
the transportation of a passenger traveling in interstate commerce by motor carrier;
the sale of passenger transportation in interstate commerce by motor carrier; or
the gross receipts derived from such transportation.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Jan. 1, 1996, except as otherwise provided in Pub. L. 104–88, see section 2 of Pub. L. 104–88, set out as a note under section 1301 of this title.
